title: VTG 1968 Sound of Music Program Dallas Summer Musicals Constance Towers
descriptionText: The VTG 1968 Sound of Music Program from Dallas Summer Musicals featuring Constance Towers is a rare and valuable piece of entertainment memorabilia. This souvenir program serves as a nostalgic keepsake from a particular production of the popular musical, showcasing the actors, crew, and other details from the show. Originating from the United States in 1968, this memorabilia captures a moment in theater history and allows fans to connect with the iconic sound and story of "The Sound of Music."
